paite: Huan Abram zi, Sarai in ta aneihsak kei hi. Sarai in Aigupta mi sikhanu khat anei a, amin Hagar ahi.
heading: Hagar Leh Ishmael
english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

paite: Sarai in Abram kiang ah, "Ngai dih ve, TOUPA'N lah ta ka neih hon phal lou a; hehpih in ka sikhanu kithuahpih in. Amah a pan tate ka neih khakleh,” achi hi. Huchi in Abram in Sarai thu azuita hi.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

paite: Kanaan gam a Abram kum sawm a-om nung in, Abram zi Sarai in asikhanu Aigupta mi api a, apasal Abram kiang ah azi ding in apia hi.
english: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

paite: Hagar athei a, huan agaita hi. Agai chih akitheihtak in, api asimmoh maimah hi.
english: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

paite: Sarai in Abram kiang ah, "Ka thil thuak amoh nang pua in. Ka sikhanu na kawi ding in ka hon pia a; agai chih akitheihtak in, hon simmoh maimah hi. TOUPA'N nang leh kei kikal ngaihtuah hen," achi hi.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May Yahweh judge between me and you.”

paite: Abram in Sarai kiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhanu na khut a om ahi, nang pha na sak bang in atung ah hih in," achi hi. Sarai in ahihgentheih mahmah tak in ataimangsanta hi.
english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

paite: TOUPA angel in gamdai a tuikhuk kiang a, Shur zotna lampi a tuikhuk kiang ah ana mu hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

paite: Akiang ah, "Hagar, Sarai sikhanu aw, koi a kipan hong pai a, koi a hoh dia kisa na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka pi Sarai kiang a kipan taimang ka hi,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”

paite: TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Na pi kiang ah kik nawn inla, athuthu in om in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”

paite: TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Na suante sim seng louh khop hial a tam in ka pungsak ding," achi nawn hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”

paite: TOUPA angel mah in akiang ah, "Ngai in, nau na paita, tapa na nei ding a; TOUPA'N na gimthuakna azak ziak in amin Ishmael na sak ding ahi.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.

paite: Amah gam-sabiltung bang ahi ding a; michih adou ding a, michih in leng amah adou ding uh. Asanggamte a kipan atuam ten ding," achi nawn hi.
english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”

paite: Hagar in amah houpih TOUPA min, "Nang muthei Pathian na hi," chih asa hi. "Pathian mu a, hing lai ka hi maw?" achi ngal a.
english: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

paite: Huaiziak in huai tuikhuk Beer-lahai-roi sak ahita. Ngai in, huai Kadesh leh Bered kho kikal a om ahi.
english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

paite: Hagar in Abram tapa aneihsak a; Abram in atapa, Hagar in aneihsak min Ishmael asata hi.
english: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

paite: Hagar in Abram a ding a Ishmael aneihsak lai in Abram kum sawmgiat-le-guk a upa ahi.
english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
